description: Transform your construction and real estate reports with Construction KPI (Targets & Progress). This modern visual, based on Material Design, offers an engaging and intuitive way to monitor project progress, sales targets, or occupancy rates, replacing standard KPI cards with rich, animated visual indicators. Key Features: - Extensive Icon Library: Over 50 high-quality vector icons focused on the sector, including Houses, Buildings, Factories, Warehouses, Castles, Stadiums, Bridges, Churches, and much more. - Progress Animation: Visualize completion percentage with a fluid animated fill effect that instantly highlights performance. - Unique Level Styles: Customize the top of the fill with varied styles such as Straight, Wave, Zig-zag, Stones, or Blocks, adding personality to your data. Advanced Customization: - Colors and Gradients: Full control over icon and background colors, with support for gradient fills. - Flexible Layout: Position the data pill above, below, or inline with the icon. Adjust sizes, shadows, and transparencies. Clear and Accurate Data: - Target Comparison: Clear display of Value vs. Target with automatic percentage calculation. - Smart Tooltips: Configure what appears on hover (value, percentage, or both). - Regional Formatting: Native support for multiple languages and number formats (dot/comma).
